scope.note: Phase 2 scope for the Piano layers; Phase 3 extends the same units to Organ (shared chain) and Synth layers. Items under excluded are never required; their panel controls exist visually but stay decorative and are listed as unsupported.
required: Six effect units per layer chain (Mod 1, Mod 2, Delay, Amp Sim/EQ, Compressor, Reverb) plus one shared Rotary
Every listed effect type selectable and audibly distinct within its unit
FX focus following layer focus, manual focus buttons, group mode, and global mode
Per-unit on/bypass, all-effects bypass, and the documented signal order
excluded: Per-type Variations and Reverb Chorale (manual p. 49-53)
Delay feedback-loop effects (Chor/Vibe/Ens/Flam/Space) and Analog mode (manual p. 51)
Rotary close mic and stop angle (manual p. 53)
Global reverb post-rotary placement nuance; reverb always precedes rotary here (manual p. 52-53)

routing.chains: Piano A, Piano B, Synth A, Synth B, Synth C each own a chain; Organ A and B share one chain (manual p. 48).
routing.allEffectsBypass: The Layer Effects ON button bypasses every effect at once (manual p. 48).
routing.groupMode: Piano and Synth chains can be grouped so all layers of the section share one effect setting (manual p. 48).
routing.globalMode: Shift+On on a global-capable unit applies it to all layers of all sections (manual p. 48).

typeNotes.Tremolo: LFO volume modulation; full level at zero amount.
typeNotes.Ring Mod: Signal multiplied by a sine; rate sets the sine pitch.
typeNotes.A-Wah: Envelope-follower band-pass sweep; rate knob acts as sensitivity.

parameters: Master Clock sync for LFO types

typeNotes.Chorus: Detuned widening; high amounts add a second delay line.
typeNotes.Phaser: Classic all-pass phasing; amount adds feedback color.
typeNotes.Vibe: Staggered phase filters with pitch-bend character.
typeNotes.Spin: Gentle rotary-like modulation; rate changes ramp gradually.

units.feedbackFilterBehavior: Each successive repeat passes through the filter again, becoming progressively more filtered (manual p. 51).

typeNotes.amps: Twin, JC, and Small are distinct tone-shaping drive/speaker colorations; a documented approximation is acceptable but the three must not sound identical.
typeNotes.filters: LP24/HP24 are resonant 24 dB filters using Freq as cutoff and Gain/Res as resonance.
typeNotes.toRotary: Routes this layer into the shared Rotary; other active units stay before it (manual p. 52).

units.behavior: Higher amounts audibly reduce dynamic range; fast mode recovers quicker and pumps at high amounts (manual p. 52).

units.typeNotes: Decay length grows from Booth (very short) to Cathedral (very long); Spring has a distinct boingy character (manual p. 52-53).

units.behavior: Models a horn plus bass rotor; speed changes accelerate smoothly. Organ routes via its button; Piano/Synth route via To Rotary (manual p. 53).

signalContract.parameterRampsRequired: Use short ramps on audible parameter changes to avoid clicks.

acceptance: Every unit and every listed type processes real audio and measurably changes a standardized rendered signal; a label, enum, or disconnected node is not an effect.
On/bypass, all-effects bypass, dry/wet, focus, group, and global targeting alter the actual signal path.
Delay feedback filtering processes the repeats rather than the dry path, and tap/clock tempo agree.
Reverb precedes Rotary for routed layers; nothing bypasses the shared master path.
Parameter changes are click-free and the graph cleans up all nodes on release.
